description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

KeyLogic, LLC is hiring a Software Engineer I to support the U.S. Department of Energy Office of Scientific and Technical Information (OSTI) mission. The role focuses on developing, maintaining, testing, and supporting software applications and data-driven solutions, primarily using Python.
Software Engineer I developing and supporting Python applications, APIs, backend services, and data-processing workflows

Responsibilities:
• Develop, maintain, test, and support software applications and services using Python and related technologies
• Collaborate with software engineers, data engineers, and subject matter experts to design and implement application features and enhancements
• Assist in the development and maintenance of APIs, data processing workflows, and backend services
• Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code following established coding standards and best practices
• Participate in code reviews, testing activities, debugging, and troubleshooting efforts
• Support the integration of applications with databases, web services, and other enterprise systems
• Work with structured and unstructured data to support application functionality and business requirements
• Contribute to application modernization efforts, automation initiatives, and process improvements
• Learn and apply software engineering principles, development methodologies, and emerging technologies

Requirements:
• Prefer candidates to have or be working toward a bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field from an accredited college or university or possess equivalent experience
• 0-3 years of software development experience required
• Experience or coursework in software development using Python
• Familiarity with object-oriented programming concepts and software development best practices
• Experience or coursework involving relational databases and SQL
• Understanding of software testing, debugging, and troubleshooting techniques
• Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Dedication to outstanding customer service
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
• Ability to work with minimal supervision

Preferred:
• Familiarity with Java programming and the ability to work within existing Java applications is a plus
• Experience working with data processing, analytics, or machine learning technologies is a plus
